scope: Boy NW run16 and combat E/W68; same-direction comparison against current user-confirmed bamboo girl
referenceAuthority: Current bamboo version explicitly accepted by user; no transfer of character, weapon, bow-event frame numbers or dynamic acceptance.
method: Actually viewed both actors complete 7-group contact sheets.
Opened four boy native originals for shoe-axis/hand-detail confirmation.
Compared foot long axis and knee-ankle connection, toe/heel relationship, support posture and arm role; not alpha minimum or mere foot separation.
Verified each reviewed exported image against its current manifest SHA; also verified all 84 boy native source SHA values.

timing.note: The720ms NW timing above is historical at the static inspection. Latest user target is uniform1200ms/run cycle=75ms/frame for all directions with no E weighting. Migration is owned by root; this note does not assert deployment or playback. Static source/pose conclusions remain unchanged; combat40/30/45ms remains.

recommendation: Retain the current 84 boy frames; no new native redraw recommended by this static comparison.

findings.observation: 01–04右支撑至蹬离、05–08左腿前摆、09–12左支撑至蹬离、13–16右腿前摆的交替可读。13/14/15当前前鞋显示靠观者的绿色后帮与金后跟，鞋尖向远方左上，未再见旧稿向左下横撇。05近侧前鞋和后腿鞋底为正常前后跨步透视。左手持葫芦，右空臂在右腿前摆半周期后摆，另一半周期向前被身体遮挡。
两鞋朝E，软膝受击后回正；右手为空，左手葫芦保留。没有仅因竹弓膝弯幅度不同而重画。
两鞋朝W；03峰值与邻帧支撑侧、鞋底方向一致，未见多脚或葫芦换手。
蓄力—右掌前推—收掌可读；10-v3的右掌位于09高位和11低位之间，放大原图确认右手未持武器。两鞋保持E向战斗支撑。
04起掌、05–07出掌、08–12回收，与左手持葫芦相容；当前04/12是普攻掌势，未混入施法双指。两鞋朝W，未见横向外八硬伤。
空右手起诀、双指前送、回收可读；葫芦仍由左手保持。E向两鞋与小腿连接合理。
02低位微抬、05半屈双指、06展开、09–11前送、12–16回收可读。05-v2原图确认右手手指与左手持葫芦分离，没有第三只手。W向鞋尖没有反向转到E。

limitations: Fine head/hip movement, foot sliding and contact duration cannot be established from static contact sheets.
The two NW cycles need phase-based interpretation; equal frame numbers are not assumed to be equal support phases.
Combat stance and arm trajectory remain boy palm/gourd mechanics; bamboo bow-specific events are not copied.
